units: metres, Blender axes at rest (Z up, face -Y); FBX export Y-up forward -Z like base_body.fbx
unityImport: Rig = Humanoid (copy avatar from base_body), Normals = Import, Read/Write on; Blend Shape Normals = Calculate for head-attached parts (brows, beards, noses, ears, hair) since expressions move them, None is fine for mouth parts; every part FBX contains the base Armature (bone names identical) so renderers can be re-pointed at the character's bones

textureConventions.brow: RGBA 512, RGB = shading, A = coverage; multiply by browColor (hair palette)
textureConventions.lids: RGBA 512, RGB = final colour of liner/shadow/lashes, A = coverage; drawn on the eye aperture only (guard mask, never across the nose bridge)
textureConventions.lips: RGBA 512, RGB = shading, A = coverage; multiply by lipTint
textureConventions.mouthInner: RGBA 512, final colours (teeth, tongue, dark), composited over lips layer
textureConventions.stubble: RGBA 512, A = hair dots; multiply by hair colour
textureConventions.iris: (legacy) RGBA 256 tint-mask iris; superseded by eyeball (eyes_hd, 512 RGB, planar front UV 0..1 of Part_Eye_L/R, iris radius 0.2 in UV) under the glossy Part_Cornea_L/R
textureConventions.lashes: RGBA 512 strand cards: upper lashes v 0.5..1, lower v 0..0.5; alpha test
textureConventions.hair: hair/hair_strands.png (+ _normal) tile on flow UVs (5 cm x 15 cm per tile, v = down the strand); hair/hair_cards.png, beard_cards.png: 4 clump columns, root v 0, tip v 1
textureConventions.browCards: brows_hd/brow_nn.png 1024x256: flush layer v 0.5..1, lifted layer v 0..0.5, u inner->outer; RGB greyscale x browColor
textureConventions.skin: skin/head_albedo_<tone>.png, head_normal/roughness/ao/cavity/lipmask.png on the head UVMap (see skin/skin_tones.json)
textureConventions.layerOrder: skin -> blush -> stubble -> brow -> lids -> lips -> mouthInner
textureConventions.colourSpace: PNGs hold display (sRGB) values: import as sRGB
